title: Multi-G1 hidden-map box-clearing puzzle
focus: Explore an unknown layout, rearrange multiple crates, coordinate shared-space access, and bring each robot to its own target.

rules.grid_planner: Privileged author-side oracle and separate observed-cell belief planner; neither moves physical bodies
rules.cooperation_claim: Shared-space coordination task; physical necessity of two robots is not established
rules.primary_goal: Both robots at their own labeled targets simultaneously; crates do not have delivery targets
agent_observation: own joint state and body-frame inertial state
rules.shared_information: No automatic map or peer-state sharing; each robot decides what to send

evaluation.primary: Each robot root is inside its own goal, upright and slow; both hold simultaneously for 2 seconds
evaluation.validity: Arrival geometry alone does not prove legal push-only execution
pending: skill robustness across perturbations and layouts

turn_doorway_yielding.scope: Four crates parked outside route; both own goals held 2 s; independent trace replay confirmed

native_box_push.scope: Actual four-crate scene; 0.211291 m plus retreat and settling; hardware-capped actuators

physical_skill_evidence.initialization_fix: Explicit initial root position removes authored MJCF height offset; old standing result used elevated start

native_one_cell_push.scope: Actual four-crate scene; 0.911273 m plus retreat and settling; sampled independent review passed

full_reference.scope: 24 actions / 8 pushes on the original four-crate level; both own goals held for 2 s; privileged reference only

observation_matched_reference.scope: One fixed four-crate development layout; 24 actions / 5 pushes; both own goals held 3 s; complete public-input CPU replay passed

symbolic.information: full map and joint discrete state

observation_matched_reference.information: own RGB, proprioception, target identity and explicit bounded messages; no global map

oracle.acceptance: Retain measured execution and independent validity checks; symbolic success alone is insufficient
oracle.artifact_contract: oracle-assessment/1: high-level plan, skill constraints, key states, budgeted checks; full trajectories optional for representative cases
